WITH latest_risk_ranked AS ( SELECT ra.risk_assessment_id, ra.inventory_balance_id, ra.forecast_id, ra.risk_grade, ra.shortage_yn, ra.risk_score, ra.reason_message, ra.updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.inventory_balance_id ORDER BY ra.updated_at DESC, ra.risk_assessment_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM risk_assessment ra WHERE ra.is_deleted = 0 ), latest_risk AS ( SELECT risk_assessment_id, inventory_balance_id, forecast_id, risk_grade, shortage_yn, risk_score, reason_message, updated_at FROM latest_risk_ranked WHERE row_no = 1 ), latest_forecast_ranked AS ( SELECT df.forecast_id, df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id, df.predicted_qty_d7, df.predicted_qty_d14, df.predicted_qty_d30, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id ORDER BY df.base_date DESC, df.updated_at DESC, df.forecast_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM demand_forecast df JOIN ml_model_version mv ON mv.model_version_id = df.model_version_id AND mv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE df.is_deleted = 0 AND df.base_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND df.forecast_source <> 'DUMMY_BASELINE' ), latest_forecast AS ( SELECT forecast_id, sku_id, sales_point_id, predicted_qty_d7, predicted_qty_d14, predicted_qty_d30 FROM latest_forecast_ranked WHERE row_no = 1 ), inventory_base AS ( SELECT ib.inventory_balance_id, ib.sku_id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, CASE WHEN ib.stock_sales_point_id IS NULL AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL THEN 'UNASSIGNED' WHEN demand_ch.channel_type = 'ONLINE' OR stock_ch.channel_type = 'ONLINE' THEN 'ONLINE' WHEN stock_ch.channel_type = 'OFFLINE' OR demand_ch.channel_type = 'OFFLINE' THEN 'OFFLINE' ELSE 'UNCLASSIFIED' END AS inventory_scope, CASE WHEN stock_ch.channel_type = 'OFFLINE' THEN 'SALES_POINT' ELSE 'WAREHOUSE' END AS stock_location_type, CASE WHEN stock_ch.channel_type = 'OFFLINE' THEN ib.stock_sales_point_id ELSE ib.warehouse_id END AS stock_location_id, CASE WHEN stock_ch.channel_type = 'OFFLINE' THEN stock_sp.sales_point_code ELSE w.warehouse_code END AS stock_location_code, CASE WHEN stock_ch.channel_type = 'OFFLINE' THEN stock_sp.sales_point_name ELSE w.warehouse_name END AS stock_location_name, ib.warehouse_id, ib.stock_sales_point_id, COALESCE(ib.allocated_sales_point_id, ib.stock_sales_point_id) AS sales_point_id, demand_sp.sales_point_code AS sales_point_code, demand_sp.sales_point_name AS sales_point_name, ib.lot_id, l.expiry_date, COALESCE(l.sale_stop_date, l.expiry_date) AS effective_sale_stop_date, ib.on_hand_qty, ib.reserved_qty, ib.total_qty AS current_qty, CASE WHEN l.lot_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND COALESCE(l.sale_stop_date, l.expiry_date) IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) < TRUNC(COALESCE(l.sale_stop_date, l.expiry_date)) AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND p.product_status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.sale_available_yn = 'Y' THEN ib.on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END AS available_qty, CASE WHEN l.lot_status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'SALE_STOPPED') AND TRUNC(l.expiry_date) >= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND TRUNC(l.expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) + 30 THEN ib.on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END AS near_expiry_qty, lr.risk_assessment_id, lr.risk_grade, lr.shortage_yn, lr.risk_score, lr.reason_message, lr.updated_at AS risk_updated_at, COALESCE(linked_df.forecast_id, fallback_df.forecast_id) AS selected_forecast_id, COALESCE(linked_df.predicted_qty_d7, fallback_df.predicted_qty_d7) AS predicted_qty_d7, COALESCE(linked_df.predicted_qty_d14, fallback_df.predicted_qty_d14) AS predicted_qty_d14, COALESCE(linked_df.predicted_qty_d30, fallback_df.predicted_qty_d30) AS predicted_qty_d30 FROM inventory_balance ib JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 JOIN product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ib.lot_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = ib.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point stock_sp ON stock_sp.sales_point_id = ib.stock_sales_point_id AND stock_sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_channel stock_ch ON stock_ch.sales_channel_id = stock_sp.sales_channel_id AND stock_ch.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point demand_sp ON demand_sp.sales_point_id = COALESCE(ib.allocated_sales_point_id, ib.stock_sales_point_id) AND demand_sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_channel demand_ch ON demand_ch.sales_channel_id = demand_sp.sales_channel_id AND demand_ch.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN latest_risk lr ON lr.inventory_balance_id = ib.inventory_balance_id LEFT JOIN demand_forecast linked_df ON linked_df.forecast_id = lr.forecast_id AND linked_df.is_deleted = 0 AND linked_df.base_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND linked_df.forecast_source <> 'DUMMY_BASELINE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ml_model_version linked_mv WHERE linked_mv.model_version_id = linked_df.model_version_id AND linked_mv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND linked_mv.is_deleted = 0 ) LEFT JOIN latest_forecast fallback_df ON fallback_df.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND fallback_df.sales_point_id = COALESCE(ib.allocated_sales_point_id, ib.stock_sales_point_id) WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND ( ib.lot_id IS NULL OR (l.lot_id IS NOT NULL AND l.lot_status <> 'DEPLETED') ) AND ( ( ib.stock_sales_point_id IS NULL AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL AND ib.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL AND w.active_yn = 'Y' AND ) OR ( demand_ch.channel_type = 'ONLINE' AND demand_ch.active_yn = 'Y' AND demand_sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND demand_sp.sales_point_code IN (
) AND ib.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL AND w.active_yn = 'Y' AND ) OR ( demand_ch.channel_type = 'OFFLINE' AND demand_sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND demand_ch.active_yn = 'Y' ) ) ), disposal_groups AS ( SELECT sku_id, inventory_scope, sales_point_id, selected_forecast_id, SUM( CASE WHEN effective_sale_stop_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND effective_sale_stop_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) + 7 THEN available_qty ELSE 0 END ) AS expiring_qty_d7, SUM( CASE WHEN effective_sale_stop_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND effective_sale_stop_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) + 14 THEN available_qty ELSE 0 END ) AS expiring_qty_d14, SUM( CASE WHEN effective_sale_stop_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND effective_sale_stop_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) + 30 THEN available_qty ELSE 0 END ) AS expiring_qty_d30, MAX(predicted_qty_d7) AS predicted_qty_d7, MAX(predicted_qty_d14) AS predicted_qty_d14, MAX(predicted_qty_d30) AS predicted_qty_d30 FROM inventory_base WHERE selected_forecast_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sku_id, inventory_scope, sales_point_id, selected_forecast_id ), expected_disposal_groups AS ( SELECT sku_id, inventory_scope, sales_point_id, GREATEST( 0, expiring_qty_d7 - predicted_qty_d7, expiring_qty_d14 - predicted_qty_d14, expiring_qty_d30 - predicted_qty_d30 ) AS expected_disposal_qty FROM disposal_groups )
mapper.select: , sku_risk AS ( SELECT sku_id, MAX( CASE risk_grade WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 3 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 2 WHEN 'GOOD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS risk_severity FROM inventory_base GROUP BY sku_id ) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(current_qty) FROM inventory_base), 0) AS total_current_stock, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(available_qty) FROM inventory_base), 0) AS total_available_stock, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN risk_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM sku_risk), 0) AS critical_sku_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN risk_severity = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM sku_risk), 0) AS warning_sku_count, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) FROM inventory_base WHERE shortage_yn = 'Y' ), 0) AS shortage_sku_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(expected_disposal_qty) FROM expected_disposal_groups), 0) AS expected_disposal_qty FROM dual

, warehouse_inventory AS ( SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(current_qty) AS current_stock, SUM(available_qty) AS available_stock, SUM(near_expiry_qty) AS near_expiry_stock, SUM(reserved_qty) AS outbound_stock, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' THEN sku_id END) AS risk_sku_count FROM inventory_base WHERE inventory_scope = 'UNASSIGNED' GROUP BY warehouse_id ) SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_code, w.warehouse_name, w.region_code, w.address, COALESCE(wi.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock, COALESCE(wi.available_stock, 0) AS available_stock, COALESCE(wi.near_expiry_stock, 0) AS near_expiry_stock, COALESCE(wi.outbound_stock, 0) AS outbound_stock, COALESCE(wi.risk_sku_count, 0) AS risk_sku_count FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN warehouse_inventory wi ON wi.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE w.active_yn = 'Y' AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND ORDER BY w.warehouse_id

, online_inventory AS ( SELECT sales_point_id, COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_id) AS storage_warehouse_count, SUM(current_qty) AS current_stock, SUM(available_qty) AS available_stock, SUM(near_expiry_qty) AS near_expiry_stock, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' THEN sku_id END) AS risk_sku_count FROM inventory_base WHERE inventory_scope = 'ONLINE' GROUP BY sales_point_id ), online_disposal AS ( SELECT sales_point_id, SUM(expected_disposal_qty) AS expected_disposal_qty FROM expected_disposal_groups WHERE inventory_scope = 'ONLINE' GROUP BY sales_point_id ) SELECT sp.sales_point_id, sp.sales_point_code, sp.sales_point_name, sp.region_code, sp.address, COALESCE(oi.storage_warehouse_count, 0) AS storage_warehouse_count, COALESCE(oi.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock, COALESCE(oi.available_stock, 0) AS available_stock, COALESCE(oi.near_expiry_stock, 0) AS near_expiry_stock, COALESCE(od.expected_disposal_qty, 0) AS expected_disposal_qty, COALESCE(oi.risk_sku_count, 0) AS risk_sku_count FROM sales_point sp JOIN sales_channel sc ON sc.sales_channel_id = sp.sales_channel_id AND sc.channel_type = 'ONLINE' AND sc.active_yn = 'Y' AND sc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN online_inventory oi ON oi.sales_point_id = sp.sales_point_id LEFT JOIN online_disposal od ON od.sales_point_id = sp.sales_point_id WHERE sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.sales_point_code IN (
) ORDER BY sp.sales_point_id

, store_inventory AS ( SELECT sales_point_id, SUM(current_qty) AS current_stock, SUM(available_qty) AS available_stock, SUM(near_expiry_qty) AS near_expiry_stock, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' THEN sku_id END) AS risk_sku_count FROM inventory_base WHERE inventory_scope = 'OFFLINE' GROUP BY sales_point_id ), store_disposal AS ( SELECT sales_point_id, SUM(expected_disposal_qty) AS expected_disposal_qty FROM expected_disposal_groups WHERE inventory_scope = 'OFFLINE' GROUP BY sales_point_id ) SELECT sp.sales_point_id, sp.sales_point_code, sp.sales_point_name, sp.region_code, sp.address, COALESCE(si.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock, COALESCE(si.available_stock, 0) AS available_stock, COALESCE(si.near_expiry_stock, 0) AS near_expiry_stock, COALESCE(sd.expected_disposal_qty, 0) AS expected_disposal_qty, COALESCE(si.risk_sku_count, 0) AS risk_sku_count FROM sales_point sp JOIN sales_channel sc ON sc.sales_channel_id = sp.sales_channel_id AND sc.channel_type = 'OFFLINE' AND sc.active_yn = 'Y' AND sc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.sales_point_id = sp.sales_point_id LEFT JOIN store_disposal sd ON sd.sales_point_id = sp.sales_point_id WHERE sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND sp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sp.sales_point_id

, sales_point_inventory AS ( SELECT sales_point_id, SUM(available_qty) AS available_stock, SUM(near_expiry_qty) AS near_expiry_stock, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' THEN sku_id END) AS risk_sku_count FROM inventory_base WHERE sales_point_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sales_point_id ), sales_point_disposal AS ( SELECT sales_point_id, SUM(expected_disposal_qty) AS expected_disposal_qty FROM expected_disposal_groups WHERE sales_point_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sales_point_id ) SELECT sp.sales_point_id, sp.sales_point_code, sp.sales_point_name, sc.channel_type, sp.region_code, COALESCE(si.available_stock, 0) AS available_stock, COALESCE(si.risk_sku_count, 0) AS risk_sku_count, COALESCE(sd.expected_disposal_qty, 0) AS expected_disposal_qty, COALESCE(si.near_expiry_stock, 0) AS near_expiry_stock FROM sales_point sp JOIN sales_channel sc ON sc.sales_channel_id = sp.sales_channel_id AND sc.active_yn = 'Y' AND sc.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sales_point_inventory si ON si.sales_point_id = sp.sales_point_id AND si.risk_sku_count > 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point_disposal sd ON sd.sales_point_id = sp.sales_point_id WHERE sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND sp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY si.risk_sku_count DESC, COALESCE(sd.expected_disposal_qty, 0) DESC, si.near_expiry_stock DESC, sp.sales_point_id ASC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

, urgent_metrics AS ( SELECT sku_id, stock_location_type, stock_location_id, MAX(risk_score) AS max_risk_score, MIN( CASE WHEN available_qty > 0 AND effective_sale_stop_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) THEN TRUNC(effective_sale_stop_date) - TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) END ) AS sale_stop_days_left, MIN( CASE WHEN available_qty > 0 AND expiry_date >= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) THEN TRUNC(expiry_date) - TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) END ) AS expiry_days_left FROM inventory_base WHERE risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' AND current_qty > 0 GROUP BY sku_id, stock_location_type, stock_location_id ), urgent_representatives AS ( SELECT ib.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sku_id, stock_location_type, stock_location_id ORDER BY risk_score DESC, risk_updated_at DESC, risk_assessment_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM inventory_base ib WHERE risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' AND current_qty > 0 ), urgent_disposal AS ( SELECT sku_id, sales_point_id, SUM(expected_disposal_qty) AS expected_disposal_qty FROM expected_disposal_groups GROUP BY sku_id, sales_point_id ) SELECT representative.sku_id, representative.sku_code, representative.sku_name, representative.stock_location_type, representative.stock_location_id, representative.stock_location_code, representative.stock_location_name, representative.sales_point_id AS allocated_sales_point_id, representative.sales_point_code AS allocated_sales_point_code, representative.sales_point_name AS allocated_sales_point_name, metrics.expiry_days_left, metrics.sale_stop_days_left, COALESCE(disposal.expected_disposal_qty, 0) AS expected_disposal_qty, representative.reason_message FROM urgent_representatives representative JOIN urgent_metrics metrics ON metrics.sku_id = representative.sku_id AND metrics.stock_location_type = representative.stock_location_type AND metrics.stock_location_id = representative.stock_location_id LEFT JOIN urgent_disposal disposal ON disposal.sku_id = representative.sku_id AND disposal.sales_point_id = representative.sales_point_id WHERE representative.row_no = 1 ORDER BY metrics.max_risk_score DESC, COALESCE(disposal.expected_disposal_qty, 0) DESC, metrics.sale_stop_days_left ASC NULLS LAST, metrics.expiry_days_left ASC NULLS LAST, representative.sku_id ASC, representative.stock_location_type ASC, representative.stock_location_id ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

, urgent_metrics AS ( SELECT sales_point_id, sku_id, stock_location_type, stock_location_id, MAX(risk_score) AS max_risk_score, MIN( CASE WHEN available_qty > 0 AND effective_sale_stop_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) THEN TRUNC(effective_sale_stop_date) - TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) END ) AS sale_stop_days_left, MIN( CASE WHEN available_qty > 0 AND expiry_date >= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) THEN TRUNC(expiry_date) - TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) END ) AS expiry_days_left FROM inventory_base WHERE risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' AND current_qty > 0 AND sales_point_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sales_point_id, sku_id, stock_location_type, stock_location_id ), urgent_representatives AS ( SELECT ib.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sales_point_id, sku_id, stock_location_type, stock_location_id ORDER BY risk_score DESC, risk_updated_at DESC, risk_assessment_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM inventory_base ib WHERE risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' AND current_qty > 0 AND sales_point_id IS NOT NULL ), urgent_disposal AS ( SELECT sku_id, sales_point_id, SUM(expected_disposal_qty) AS expected_disposal_qty FROM expected_disposal_groups WHERE sales_point_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sku_id, sales_point_id ), ranked_urgent AS ( SELECT representative.sku_id, representative.sku_code, representative.sku_name, representative.stock_location_type, representative.stock_location_id, representative.stock_location_code, representative.stock_location_name, representative.sales_point_id AS allocated_sales_point_id, representative.sales_point_code AS allocated_sales_point_code, representative.sales_point_name AS allocated_sales_point_name, metrics.expiry_days_left, metrics.sale_stop_days_left, COALESCE(disposal.expected_disposal_qty, 0) AS expected_disposal_qty, representative.reason_message, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY representative.sales_point_id ORDER BY metrics.max_risk_score DESC, COALESCE(disposal.expected_disposal_qty, 0) DESC, metrics.sale_stop_days_left ASC NULLS LAST, metrics.expiry_days_left ASC NULLS LAST, representative.sku_id ASC, representative.stock_location_type ASC, representative.stock_location_id ASC ) AS sales_point_rank FROM urgent_representatives representative JOIN urgent_metrics metrics ON metrics.sales_point_id = representative.sales_point_id AND metrics.sku_id = representative.sku_id AND metrics.stock_location_type = representative.stock_location_type AND metrics.stock_location_id = representative.stock_location_id LEFT JOIN urgent_disposal disposal ON disposal.sku_id = representative.sku_id AND disposal.sales_point_id = representative.sales_point_id WHERE representative.row_no = 1 ) SELECT sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, stock_location_type, stock_location_id, stock_location_code, stock_location_name, allocated_sales_point_id, allocated_sales_point_code, allocated_sales_point_name, expiry_days_left, sale_stop_days_left, expected_disposal_qty, reason_message FROM ranked_urgent WHERE sales_point_rank <= 5 ORDER BY allocated_sales_point_id, sales_point_rank
